label: FACIS DSP — Data Pull
info:
GET /api/data/:assetId — HTTP Pull Profile data endpoint (NF-2 /
FR-DL-001). Verifies the HMAC-signed URL produced by dsp-tx-create's
provisionHttpPull() (see facis-dsp-transfers.json), then serves the
requested Gold-layer dataset from Trino (facis-dsp-data.json / Task 2).

Replaces the ai-insight-service Python stub at the same literal path
(services/ai-insight-service/src/api/rest/routes/dsp.py's data_router),
which only ever returned {"status":"authorized"} and — separately — was
never reachable via the live Ingress at all (no /api/data rule existed
there until this flow added one; see infrastructure/ingress/facis-ingress.yaml).
The Python route is left in place but is now dead code; not deleted here,
see orce/README.md's NF-2 section for why.

name: verify HMAC signature
catalogue lookup
query Trino
